items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: And then the Alhambra, where I saw Florence Mills, was on the Seventh Avenue side.

ctx.x: And then the Alhambra, where I saw Florence Mills, was on the Seventh Avenue side. Up above the (?) was the Rose Danceland, not the Roseland Danceland, the Red Rose -- where Johnny Russell played with Billy Cato's band. They used to throw the trombone out in the window. I can remember that.
Billy Cato was a trombone player?
